label_source: Repository documents/policies/schema only; no implementation or observed v2 decision used.

binding.rule: Actual complete request digest must equal the signed envelope digest; scalar fields must agree. Changed requests have no authority under the original token.
binding.section: Strict gateway execution context and live token status

canonical.rule: Sorted object keys and insignificant JSON whitespace do not change canonical bytes; array order and opaque identifier strings are not normalized by this rule.

conflict.rule: cross_signal_inconsistency triggers GLOBAL-EVIDENCE-CONFLICT before policy-specific authorization, returns escalate with no token.

evidence_age.rule: Observation age must be less than 60 seconds; exactly 60 is expired; future skew greater than 5 seconds is invalid.

expiry.rule: Execution at or beyond the earliest evidence/envelope/approval/token deadline refuses; expiry is rechecked at commit.
expiry.section: Time boundary; Strict gateway execution context and live token status

fresh_intent.rule: New request IDs can express repeated semantic intent; semantic deduplication is not supplied. A fully freshly attested, authorized, in-scope request remains eligible.

no_maximum.rule: Opaque identifiers have minimum lengths but no maxLength; evidence digest allows 16 through 128 lowercase hex characters. Matching trusted allowlists and all other approval requirements still apply.

optional_undefined.ambiguity: There is no optional envelope metadata field to omit. Probe unchanged input with absent nonexistent metadata, disclose this coverage gap, and do not invent an optional-field contract.
optional_undefined.rule: All 17 current wire fields are required and additionalProperties is false.

partial_audit.rule: Injected audit failure after replay consumption cannot produce a successful receipt; the consumed attempt stays consumed and its retry refuses.

replay.rule: Atomically consume token ID and execution idempotency key before a receipt; consumption survives audit failure; no retry by erasing state.

revocation.rule: Unknown, revoked, mismatched, wrongly purposed or unavailable live authority must refuse. Registry lock orders revocation before or after receipt commit.
revocation.section: Strict gateway execution context and live token status

rollback_undefined.ambiguity: No enforceable monotonic-clock or allowed rollback tolerance is specified; observe without inventing a label.
rollback_undefined.rule: Operators must supply a trustworthy clock; rollback is not independently detected. A deliberately rolled-back clock has no documented safe decision.

schema.rule: Reject unsupported versions, missing required or unknown fields and malformed original decoded input; no coercion/defaulting.

sidecar_optional.ambiguity: Omit empty approvals on a policy needing no approval; docs do not distinguish empty array from absent optional sidecar array.
sidecar_optional.rule: Sidecar contains evidence and approvals arrays, but optional omission/default behavior of an empty approvals array is not expressly specified.

state.rule: Missing, corrupt or locked SQLite state fails closed; explicit provisioning required; no fallback.

valid.also: docs/ASSURANCE_BOUNDARY.md: Trust and authority; Time boundary
valid.rule: Exact allowed action/scope, configured confidence, required signals, authenticated independent sources, reversibility and required independent approvals satisfy the selected approving policy.
